summary: The current codebase provides a solid skeleton (entities, parameters, and data loaders) but lacks the core simulation loop, calibration, prediction, and metric computation. As a result, no time series or evaluation metrics are produced. The most critical fixes are to: implement the run loop with peer influence, information and policy propagation; compute and store daily adoption rates; calibrate parameters using train_data (days 0-29) and generate out-of-sample predictions (days 30-39); and report the specified metrics and validations.

critical_issues.issue: No simulation loop or stepping logic is implemented
critical_issues.impact: No time series (adoption rates) or metrics are produced, preventing any evaluation (RMSE and others) and policy effect analysis
critical_issues.solution: Implement Simulation.run() and a per-step update that: (1) computes layer-weighted peer mask rates, (2) broadcasts information, (3) applies policy from Day 10, (4) updates beliefs and adoption, (5) updates group norms, (6) collects metrics and time series

critical_issues.issue: Training and prediction phases are absent
critical_issues.impact: Cannot fit influence/policy coefficients nor generate predictions for days 30-39; RMSE over holdout is not computable
critical_issues.solution: Add a simple logistic hazard calibration on days 0-29 to estimate alpha (risk), beta (peer), delta (info), gamma (policy), theta (intercept), and optional quadratic peer term; then run forward simulation to predict days 30-39

critical_issues.issue: Data paths are not derived from model_plan.data_folder
critical_issues.impact: Files may not be found in deployments; code silently falls back to synthetic data, making real-world evaluation impossible
critical_issues.solution: Use model_plan['data_folder'] inside Simulation._initialize_from_data_or_synthetic to build AGENTS_FILE, NETWORK_FILE, TRAIN_FILE paths instead of module-level globals

critical_issues.issue: InformationSource and PolicyAuthority are never invoked in a loop
critical_issues.impact: No information or policy effects are present; cannot assess Day-10 policy intervention or information propagation
critical_issues.solution: In each step, randomly broadcast information to agents, set agent.received_info flags, apply PolicyAuthority.issue_or_update_policy(t), enforce_policy(), and broadcast_guidance()

critical_issues.issue: No metrics or validations computed or reported
critical_issues.impact: Cannot evaluate fit (RMSE), adoption dynamics (time_to_threshold, steady_state_adoption), clustering (assortativity), group gaps, or convergence/robustness
critical_issues.solution: Compute and store all specified metrics, output as a stable JSON schema; implement bounds checks, limiting-case sanity tests, and seed robustness

critical_issues.issue: Peer influence is not computed from the network per agent
critical_issues.impact: Adoption decision lacks social context; cannot model diffusion dynamics or clustering
critical_issues.solution: Compute per-agent, per-layer neighbor mask rates excluding ego, aggregate via layer_weights, and feed into adoption hazard
Define prediction period explicitly and ensure the simulation produces and exports adoption_rate for each holdout day

model_improvements.current_approach: Fixed coefficients in Simulation.__init__ with no data-driven calibration
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Fit a discrete-time logistic regression on days 0-29 using features: risk_perception, layer-weighted peer_rate_t-1 (and its square), info flag, policy flag; estimate intercept and coefficients
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Improved alignment with observed diffusion dynamics and accurate holdout predictions (lower RMSE)

model_improvements.current_approach: Not implemented; Person.observe_neighbors averages an input dict but simulation never supplies realistic per-layer rates
model_improvements.suggested_approach: For each agent and layer, compute masked_neighbors / degree_layer excluding ego; combine via layer_weights to get peer_rate_agg
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Realistic social contagion and clustering dynamics, enabling assortativity and exposure metrics

model_improvements.current_approach: PolicyAuthority exists but is never applied in a loop
model_improvements.suggested_approach: At each step t: activate policy at t>=10, enforce with probability, broadcast guidance; incorporate policy flag and effect into adoption hazard
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Captures policy-driven increases in adoption and improves match to real-world patterns after Day 10

model_improvements.current_approach: InformationSource.broadcast exists but recipients are never applied to agents
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Set agent.received_info for recipients; decay/reset with info_decay_prob; use effect_size in belief/adoption updates
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Models exogenous shocks and peer-shared information, improving diffusion speed and timing

model_improvements.current_approach: Fixed abandonment probability modulated by 1 - peer_rate
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Estimate abandonment_prob from 1->0 transitions in train_data; scale by (1 - peer_rate)^k with k>1 to reflect social pressure
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic de-adoption dynamics and late-phase plateau behavior

model_improvements.suggested_approach: Add convergence check over observation_window, seed robustness over >=10 seeds, limiting-cases sanity, and probability bounds checks
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Reliability and correctness guarantees for the simulation outputs

code_improvements.modification: Implement Simulation.run() and a per-day step that wires together peer influence, info broadcast, policy, belief update, adoption decisions, group norm updates, and metric collection
code_improvements.reason: Core functionality required to produce time series and metrics

code_improvements.reason: Ensures data alignment with task specification and prevents silent fallback to synthetic data

code_improvements.reason: Data-driven calibration is necessary for valid out-of-sample predictions and RMSE computation

code_improvements.reason: Required by evaluation and validation; enables automated assessment and iteration

code_improvements.reason: Ensures downstream evaluation always has consumable outputs

Compute per-group adoption rates over time and report max-min (or Gini) across groups each day; validate against known group-level patterns

def _initialize_from_data_or_synthetic(self) -> None:
    data_root = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, self.model_plan.get("data_folder", ""))
    agents_file = os.path.join(data_root, "agent_attributes.csv")
    network_file = os.path.join(data_root, "social_network.json")
    train_file = os.path.join(data_root, "train_data.csv")

    agent_df = self._load_agents_dataframe(agents_file) or self._generate_synthetic_agents(self.population_size)
    self.population_size = int(len(agent_df))

    loaded_network = self._load_social_network(network_file) or self._generate_synthetic_network(agent_df["agent_id"].tolist(), self.average_degree)
    self._build_layer_adjacency(loaded_network)
    ...

def run(self) -> None:
    # Optional: calibrate using train_data (days 0-29)
    self._maybe_calibrate_from_train()
    self.daily_new_adoptions = []
    for t in range(self.simulation_steps):
        self.policy.issue_or_update_policy(t)
        # 1) Information broadcast
        recipients_all = set()
        for src in self.info_sources:
            recipients = src.broadcast_message(t, self.agents)
            recipients_all |= recipients
        for aid in recipients_all:
            self.agents[aid].received_info = True
        # 2) Compute peer rates per agent
        peer_rate_agg = self._compute_peer_rates_agg()
        # 3) Group norm update (previous state)
        for grp in self.groups.values():
            grp.update_norm_from_members(self.agents)
        # 4) Adoption decisions
        new_adopters = set()
        for aid, agent in self.agents.items():
            grp_norm = self.groups[agent.group_id].broadcast_group_norm() if agent.group_id in self.groups else 0.0
            agent.update_beliefs(
                info_signal=self.message_effect_size if agent.received_info else 0.0,
                peer_pressure=peer_rate_agg.get(aid, 0.0),
                group_norm=grp_norm,
                noise_std=self.noise_std
            )
            agent.decide_adopt_or_abandon(
                t=t,
                risk_weight=self.alpha_risk_weight,
                peer_weight=self.beta_peer_influence,
                peer_rate_agg=peer_rate_agg.get(aid, 0.0),
                info_effect=self.delta_info_effect,
                has_policy=self.policy.mandate_active,
                policy_effect=self.gamma_policy_effect,
                intercept=self.theta_intercept,
                quadratic_peer=self.nonlinearity_peer_quadratic,
                abandonment_prob=self.abandonment_rate,
                compliance_ceiling=self.compliance_ceiling
            )
            if agent.has_ever_adopted and agent.last_adoption_day == t:
                new_adopters.add(aid)
        # 5) Policy enforcement
        self.policy.enforce_policy(self.agents)
        # 6) Reset info with decay
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            if agent.received_info and random.random() < self.info_decay_prob:
                agent.received_info = False
        # 7) Metrics
        self._record_metrics(t, new_adopters)

    # After run: compute holdout RMSE if real data available
    self._compute_holdout_rmse()
